load_scale_dict_from_json: load scale factors from a JSON file mapping scale factor names to scale values
load_scale_dict_from_pt: load scale factors from a pickled PyTorch .pt file mapping scale factor names to values
load_scales_into_module: load scale factors from a file or dict into an nn.Module with ScaleFactor submodules
validate_scale_factors: validate that all ScaleFactor submodules in a module have corresponding entries in the scale dict
apply_scale_to_module: apply loaded scale values to ScaleFactor submodules by calling set_ on each matching module
